name: pos-state-high-active-count
description: WARN: many instruments stuck ACTIVE (indefinite block, no TTL). compute.signal.active.count >100 for 10m. Investigation: query Position_State lake WHERE status=OPEN; if closing feedback lost, use ADMIN_CLEAR break-glass (emits trading_alerts active-signal-admin-clear). Correctness: block never auto-expires.

name: pos-state-high-dropped-rate
description: INFO: high suppression rate — many signals dropped because ACTIVE exists (strict max-one, indefinite). compute.signal.dropped.active_exists rate >5/s for 5m. Not an error; indicates either stuck ACTIVE or bursting signals for already-positioned instruments. Correlate with panel 1 gauge and trading_alerts active-signal-cleared rate.

name: pos-state-admin-clear-break-glass
description: CRITICAL audit: ADMIN_CLEAR break-glass used — ops manually cleared an ACTIVE instrument (Position_State status=ADMIN_CLEAR). Realtime. Review trading_alerts body for token/clearedActive/activeCount. Must have ticket + approval trail; verify Position_State source before clearing.
